reason: Replace broad enum and invalid filters with one exact integration target and zero-test failure semantics.

acceptance_criteria: Every restricted current-v2 field is inventoried with stored string, Rust type, parser/formatter, schema, editor, validator, Markdown, and test ownership
Every field has a source-backed typed_complete, finite_gap, or intentionally_extensible disposition
Only the smallest coherent finite_gap family changes code; no-gap results retain a reviewed no-duplicate-work disposition
A changed finite field has one canonical parse, display, serde, allowed-value, schema, editor, validator, and diagnostic authority
Existing valid values JSON and rendered Markdown round-trip without drift and active template structure/schema parity remains intact
Invalid values fail deterministically and any supported legacy alias normalizes only at an explicit tested boundary
Sunset v1 authority, template redesign, wire-format migration, and extensible identifier typing remain excluded
The exact csdlc-v2/tests/prompt_card_enum_typing.rs target proves round-trip/schema and invalid-value/legacy behavior with zero tests treated as failure

steps.action: Inventory every restricted field and declare the exact prompt_card_enum_typing integration target
If a finite gap exists, implement the smallest shared enum authority across current v2 boundaries
Run inventory, exact no-tests-fail target, no-duplicate-work, and exact-revision proof

validation_lanes.proof_role: Validate complete field ownership and one disposition per restricted current-v2 field.
argv: r=JSON.parse(File.read('.csdlc/evidence/5824/enum-inventory.json')); abort('empty') unless r.is_a?(Array)&&!r.empty?; allowed=%w[typed_complete finite_gap intentionally_extensible]; abort('bad row') unless r.all?{|x|x['field'].to_s!=''&&allowed.include?(x['disposition'])&&x['stored_string']&&x['owners'].is_a?(Hash)}; abort('duplicate') unless r.map{|x|x['field']}.uniq.length==r.length

validation_lanes.proof_role: Run the exact prompt_card_enum_typing integration target for round-trip/schema and invalid-value/legacy behavior; zero tests fail.
Reject whitespace and unintended template or sunset-v1 changes.
